# AL1313: Forward CancellationToken to invocations that support it

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| -- | -- |
| Severity | Info |

| Analyzer | `Al1313CancellationTokenPropagationAnalyzer` |

## Description

When a CancellationToken is available in scope and the invoked method has an overload accepting one, forward it to enable cooperative cancellation.
